title: cuproptosis-review: analysis code and derived tables for a critical review of copper-ionophore selectivity
description: Scripts and derived tables supporting a critical review of copper ionophores in cancer therapy. Includes the selectivity-index computation (TCGA/GTEx TOIL RSEM), the GDSC2 dose-range analysis, the label-permutation null for the coordination programme, and the literature-audit scripts. Primary data are public (UCSC Xena; GDSC2 release 8.5) and are not redistributed here.
